# Android host tests that already fail on enhanced.
# Blank lines and lines whose first non-whitespace character is # are not entries.
# Each remaining line is one test result: classname.method, including a Robolectric SDK suffix.
# The pull request job fails only when a result is not listed here.
#
# AndroidDownloadLifecycleTest, two results.
# Robolectric's JobScheduler.schedule() returns success, so restore() reschedules the transfer
# and leaves it Downloading. The test expects Paused. @Config(sdk = [34, 36]) records the
# SDK 34 run with a [34] suffix and the other run with no suffix.
com.nuvio.app.features.downloads.AndroidDownloadLifecycleTest.missingSystemJobIsPausedInsteadOfSilentlyRescheduling[34]
com.nuvio.app.features.downloads.AndroidDownloadLifecycleTest.missingSystemJobIsPausedInsteadOfSilentlyRescheduling
#
# DeleteDownloadWhenFinishedTest
# WatchingActions.onProgressEntryUpdated calls FinishedDownloadDeletion.onPlaybackCompleted,
# which does nothing. Removal is queued from onLocalProgress. These tests still use the old
# completion hook, so the file, partial, subtitles, and row are all still there when the wait ends.
com.nuvio.app.features.downloads.DeleteDownloadWhenFinishedTest.completedPlaybackRemovesTheFileSubtitlesAndRowAfterThePlayerLeaves
com.nuvio.app.features.downloads.DeleteDownloadWhenFinishedTest.scrubbingBackKeepsTheFileUntilPlaybackLeaves
com.nuvio.app.features.downloads.DeleteDownloadWhenFinishedTest.movingToAnotherVideoRemovesTheFinishedDownload
com.nuvio.app.features.downloads.DeleteDownloadWhenFinishedTest.completionAfterTheBytesFinishStillRemovesTheDownload
#
# DownloadSubtitlesTest.backgroundDownloadSavesAddonAndStreamSubtitlesBeforeVideo
# Subtitle fetches run beside the video transfer. The test requires the video request to be last;
# this run recorded /french last.
com.nuvio.app.features.downloads.DownloadSubtitlesTest.backgroundDownloadSavesAddonAndStreamSubtitlesBeforeVideo
